name: MPAC Sports UAE
headline: #1 Basketball School For Youth & Adults with classes in Dubai
lede: MPAC Sports, the premier basketball academy in Dubai, Abu Dhabi, and across the UAE.
about: MPAC was Founded in Chicago, Illinois in 2002 by Luqman Rashad. Chicago is the home of basketball in the United States Of America, and also the stomping ground of the legendary MICHAEL Jordan and Chicago Bulls.

MPAC Sports Center is located in 15-25A Street, Al Qouz 1, Dubai. Enjoy playing in the best indoor basketball court now in Dubai - air conditioned, hard wood flooring and well designed with NBA players.
